standard_prerequisites.use: Constructs the Postnikov system of an object from a resolution; produces the triangles and the hocolim identification in the special case.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 3447-3471): with X_n = (g_{n!}O_n) tensor^L_O K and Y_n = (g_{n!}O_n -> ... -> g_{0!}O_0)[-n] tensor^L_O K, the distinguished triangles Y_n -> X_n -> Y_{n-1} -> Y_n[1] form a Postnikov system for ... -> X_2 -> X_1 -> X_0 and K = hocolim Y_n[n] in D(O).

Special case K = O (proof lines 3473-3483): this is the Derived Categories key example applied to the resolution complex ... -> g_{2!}O_2 -> g_{1!}O_1 -> g_{0!}O_0, which represents K = O in D(C_total) by the ringed simplicial resolution lemma.

General case (lines 3483-3490): the general K follows because the exact functor - tensor^L_O K sends Postnikov systems to Postnikov systems and commutes with homotopy colimits, so the special-case triangles and hocolim identification transport to K.
proof_roadmap: Prove the K = O case by applying the key Postnikov example to the resolution complex.
Transport to general K by the exact derived tensor functor preserving Postnikov systems and hocolims.
difficulty_reason: Postnikov-system lemma (statement 3447-3471, proof 3473-3490): the module-case Postnikov system - the proof handles K = O by the Derived Categories key example applied to the resolution (representing O by the in-source ringed resolution lemma) and transports to general K by the two standard exactness properties of derived tensor; the reduction structure is explicit and complete. H2.
